Monday's session was a tale of two sectors for Jaleel's book. Healthcare and medtech led the gainers: Boston Scientific (BSX) added 2.6%, Abbott (ABT) rose 2.23%, and top holding Zoetis (ZTS) tacked on 1.12% — meaningful given those three together account for over 31% of the book. S&P Global (SPGI) and On Holding (ONON) also posted modest gains. The drag came from the growth and tech sleeve: Rocket Lab (RKLB) fell 3.67%, NVIDIA (NVDA) dropped 1.29% on a report that OpenAI's annualized revenue may be roughly $20 billion below prior estimates — a sentiment hit for compute-exposed semis — and Broadcom (AVGO) slid 1.88% on the same headline. ADBE shed 1.7% and AutoZone (AZO) gave back 1.39%.

The drift problem is concentrated and worth naming plainly. BSX is the book's third-largest weight at 9.3% yet sits on a -10.6% unrealized loss after a guidance slash; the next catalyst is October 28 earnings, which is now a near-term binary. LULU carries a -26.0% unrealized loss on a guidance cut with Americas comps down five straight quarters — today's +0.17% did nothing to close the gap between the STRONG BUY verdict and the fundamental picture. RKLB's AVOID verdict paired with a -16.1% unrealized loss and today's -3.67% session move is an open contradiction that keeps compounding.

Looking to Tuesday, watch whether the OpenAI revenue revision continues to pressure NVDA and AVGO, and keep BSX's October 28 print front of mind — the risk flag flags flat guidance through Q3, so a miss or further cut would land hard on a position already underwater.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name down 3.67% today, -16.1% unrealized — thesis and verdict are fully misaligned
attention.note: The system rates this AVOID with a QARP of 38.8 (lowest in the book by a wide margin), the position is deep in the red and still losing ground; there is no stated catalyst to close the gap, making continued holding the decision that needs justification.

attention.headline: October 28 earnings in 16 days; guidance already slashed, -10.6% unrealized on a 9.3% weight
attention.note: BSX is the third-largest position in the book and carries an elevated risk flag for a FY26 growth cut with management guiding flat through Q3 — earnings in two weeks is a hard decision point on whether to reduce exposure ahead of a potential further cut.

attention.headline: -26.0% unrealized loss on an elevated guidance-cut flag; today's +0.17% is noise
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and China stalling have driven a -26.0% loss, yet the verdict remains STRONG BUY — the divergence between the conviction rating and the fundamental deterioration needs an explicit reassessment before the December 9 print.

attention.headline: OpenAI revenue-shortfall report hit semis today; export-control risk flag still live ahead of Nov 17
attention.note: Today's -1.29% was driven by a demand-sentiment shock in AI compute, layered on top of an existing watch flag for China export-license tightening and Senate scrutiny — the combination of narrative and regulatory pressure warrants monitoring the position into the November 17 earnings date.
